entities.title: Who may fetch what
entities.summary: Signed out, signed in without the role, and invited, for the page and for its files; other paths and methods.
criteria: The address is /games/lundey and the role is games:lundey
A visitor who is not signed in is redirected to sign in and back, for the page, the script and the icon alike
A signed-in player holding games:play and games:recreations but not games:lundey gets the not-invited page with 403, never stored, for all three
An invited player gets the page (private, no-cache) and the script (private, max-age=3600), and a 404 for a file the build does not make
A path outside the game is 404, a POST is 405, and the bare address redirects to its slash

checks.symbol: the game lives at /games/lundey, for holders of games:lundey
a visitor who isn't signed in is sent to sign in and back
a signed-in player without the role gets the not-invited page, and none of the game
an invited player gets the page and the files, privately
nothing outside the game is answered; no writes; the bare address gets its slash

notChecked: The real login service and the real sign-in pages: the tests stand in for ACCOUNTS with an object that knows two players.
Cloudflare's static assets and the headers in public/_headers: the tests stand in for ASSETS.
The deployed Worker: it has not been deployed (games/lundey/.dev/blockers.json, first-deploy).
